detail:
Reproduced by scripts/qualify/c28-remote (assert phase, C28 A13) on both replicas. Setup: boris holds read-only in svc/ledger/; his successor record E21-rec is correctly rejected with reason `unauthorized`, but the `superseded` event E21 that cites it settles to state `pending_parents` with reason "waiting on <two ids>" and never terminates — on store-A (producer, direct append) and store-B (consumer, over the carrier).

Why it matters: C28 A13 requires "the rejection is a receipt state, not an absence". C18 A9 requires every incomplete effect to be enumerable with a state, an age and a reason, and the enumerated count to equal the count derivable from the delivery view. An event waiting on a parent that can never arrive is a permanent, unbounded entry in any gap report, and the producer never learns its claim was refused.

Smallest reproduction: npx tsx scripts/qualify/c28-remote/c28-scenario.ts seed|publish|poll|assert --work <dir> --carrier fs — A13 reports fail with the final state printed.

Suggested disposition (lane 02 owns src/events/event-store.ts): when settling an event to `pending_parents`, check whether any id in pending_on is already terminal-rejected in the journal; if so settle to `rejected` with a reason naming the rejected parent. The separable half already works and is asserted as A13-auth.
summary: F-PENDING (lane 02): an event whose causal parent is REJECTED stays pending_parents forever instead of terminating in a refusal with a reason
